skills.description: Seeing the one detail that is a degree out of place.
skills.name: Observation
skills.voice: Flat, patient, faintly pleased with itself.

skills.description: Pressing a person until the shape of the lie shows.
skills.name: Rhetoric
skills.voice: Warm on the surface. Not underneath.

skills.description: Sitting with someone long enough that they fill the silence.
skills.name: Empathy

skills.description: Holding still when the room would rather you did not.
skills.name: Nerve
skills.voice: Says almost nothing. Does not look away.
